i2cFindAddresses.summary: Scans a configured bus for responding addresses without ID-register identification.
i2cFindAddresses.returns: Scan status text, or Error plus the backend diagnostic.
prerequisites: Import I2C Devices and its declared dependencies.
inputs: 1. scan I2C bus: number; library example 0.

examples.title: Use scan I2C bus …
examples.explanation: Block notation: Scans a configured bus for responding addresses without ID-register identification. Scan status text, or Error plus the backend diagnostic.

examples.title: Inspect before reading
examples.code:
scan I2C bus [0]
devices found
device [1] bus address
device [1] identification
examples.explanation: Only use device index 1 when the completed scan reports at least one device. Address-only discovery does not prove sensor identity; do not read arbitrary registers.

notes: Find devices on a configured I2C bus. Bus 0 on P4 uses SDA7/SCL8. Start with identify=false for address-only probing; true permits documented ID-register reads, not initialization. An address is not a confirmed identity. Read only measurements listed for a confirmed device. Camera/codec readings are registers, not images or sound. TMP117 temperature needs an attached sensor and is reported as text in degrees C; numeric last value uses milli-degrees C (scale 1000). Scan replaces device references. Stop All cancels. Do not scan an active camera/audio capture. No reset/configuration/mux switching occurs.
Source: boards\waveshare_esp32p4_wifi6\integration\I2C_Devices.ubl. Examples are illustrative block notation, not hardware acceptance tests.
